blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Prepare the candidate for release-convergence recapture by restoring the ordinary authored run lifecycle and spatial integrity, while making the dense final-wave profile deterministic, bounded, and renderer-qualified without regressing the preserved presentation.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release gate still lacks a verified ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper route with clean restart, while dense qualification has no completed native three-cycle profile because the current run is on llvmpipe. Prior diagnostic fixtures and telemetry did not establish ordinary reachability or native performance evidence.

stop_conditions: Author exactly two bounded tasks covering the two required gaps once each.
Do not assign deferred issues or backlog gaps as current-loop issue work.
Do not replace the preserved authored CemeteryGarden package or prescribe a named asset/reference.

strategy.rationale: Use two materially different root-cause families: authoritative route/state and authored-world spatial repair for ordinary play, plus deterministic dense-load lifecycle and low-overhead profiling for performance qualification. This moves beyond prior camera-only or evidence-only treatments.

code: Run focused static and unit checks for authoritative wave transitions, Bellkeeper victory eligibility, Retry reset/disposal, upgrade draft transaction and focus navigation, dense profile sampling, pooling cleanup, and release-export diagnostic guards.
Verify native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation checks remain passing.
runtime: Tester/Runtime recapture ordinary movement replay through all five waves and Bellkeeper defeat or failure, then Result → Retry for three clean cycles; collect runtime state, scene-tree, collision/boundary, reset, upgrade-selection, and error-log evidence.

Tester recapture the dense profile at 1920x1080 on the eligible native renderer for three complete prepare/advance/reset cycles, comparing frame-time, 25–40 enemy load, high-churn counts, memory/object deltas, and logs against the contract thresholds.
visual: Capture shipped-gameplay views at spawn, critical route, central landmark before/near/after contact, perimeter, dense final wave, Result, and post-Retry; confirm external depth, stable collision, no disappearance or occlusion, and readable escape lanes.

Capture the level-up draft at native presentation scale with each input focus state, confirming authored silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new hierarchy, at most three deltas, and no placeholder CURRENT values; compare baseline and dense frames with diagnostics hidden.

done_when: A fresh ordinary run uses ordinary movement to traverse a larger traversable scale, completes five authored waves including the Bellkeeper encounter, reaches a truthful victory or failure Result, and never relies on a synthetic victory fixture.

The authored CemeteryGarden remains the central building/landmark with coherent external world/external depth; collision and visible geometry agree, the boundary/perimeter prevents pass-through, and movement replay around the landmark and perimeter shows no disappearance or occlusion.

Result and Retry perform a complete authoritative reset of wave/director state, player and enemy occupancy, pickups, XP/upgrade transaction, timers, signals, pause ownership, audio, and HUD focus; three consecutive restart cycles are clean.

The level-up page presents each choice with an authored silhouette/icon, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no NEW or LOCKED placeholder in CURRENT, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/confirm states.
Tester can black-box replay spawn → wave 1 → wave 5/Bellkeeper → Result → Retry three times and white-box inspect run, collision, boundary, reset, and selected-upgrade state with no runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative ordinary five-wave route and restart lifecycle around the existing authored CemeteryGarden. Expand the playable area to a larger traversable scale while retaining a coherent external world/external depth beyond the gameplay boundary. Rebase spawn, objective anchors, navigation, collision, and perimeter/boundary checks to native authored streets or terrain; remove proxy/support clutter that masks contacts. Ensure ordinary movement/movement replay around every side of the central building/landmark and along the full boundary cannot pass through geometry, hide the player or enemies inside it, or cause landmark disappearance or camera occlusion. Make wave progression, Bellkeeper defeat, victory/failure, Result, and Retry derive from one authoritative state machine, with full disposal/reset of actors, pools, timers, signals, audio, pause reasons, and input ownership. In the same run-state seam, finish the player-facing upgrade choice hierarchy with authored visual anchors, compact icons, truthful current-to-new deltas (maximum three), and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus behavior. Keep any deterministic tester preparation isolated from release exports and never use it as ordinary-route evidence.
tasks.title: Restore ordinary five-wave route, spatial integrity, upgrade hierarchy, and Retry lifecycle

done_when: A deterministic dense scenario in the real gameplay scene reaches 25–40 simultaneously active ordinary enemies plus the player, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI, audio, and the final-wave/Bellkeeper load at 1920x1080.

The profile records nonzero frame-time distribution, active and spawned enemy/projectile counts, spawn/despawn rates, pool/object or memory deltas, and reset-isolation receipts for three complete cycles.

The largest measured high-churn costs are bounded through candidate changes such as pooling, scheduled/staggered updates, capped spawn batches, and guaranteed cleanup, without changing automatic-combat causality or wave semantics.
Two consecutive dense runs after a clean reset show no runaway growth, renderer stalls, or error logs, and baseline gameplay presentation remains readable with diagnostics hidden from release output.
tasks.instructions: Make the existing dense_profile path deterministic and recapturable in the shipped gameplay scene so native renderer qualification can be performed. Exercise the contract's 1920x1080 representative final wave and Bellkeeper load with 25–40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI, and audio. Instrument frame-time distribution, active/spawned/despawned enemies and projectiles, spawn cadence, pool occupancy, and memory/object deltas behind a tester-only or release-safe diagnostic guard. Profile the actual wave director, encounter spawner, enemy actors, attack/projectile presentation, and pickup lifecycle; fix proven hotspots with bounded pooling, staggered decisions, capped batches, and complete reset cleanup while preserving targeting, damage, upgrade effects, and readability. Ensure prepare/advance/reset sequencing can run three isolated cycles and diagnostics/actions are unavailable in release exports.
tasks.title: Make dense final-wave profiling deterministic and stable
